summary.intent: Resolve review findings on PR #470 (change #78), clean up merged/stale local branches and worktrees (including the slopfix ones the user asked about), and then fix a failing CI check on #470.
summary.outcome: Resolved the three #78 findings, deleted 16 stale local branches plus the five slopfix worktrees/branches (uncommitted diffs archived first), and fixed the clippy CI failure by moving group_operations above the test module. Fix was committed and pushed, with a gate check run afterward, but the final CI result isn't shown. Remote branch deletes were blocked by the classifier and left for the user.

repo: Review findings are resolved with `entire trail finding resolve <id> --branch <branch> -m <msg>`, and gate status is viewed with `entire trail show <n>`.

CI for callisto runs fmt, clippy with -D warnings (callisto-graph, callisto-cli, all targets), rustdoc with -D warnings, and the callisto-graph/callisto-cli test suites. Run all of these locally before pushing.
Work happens in worktrees under .claude/worktrees/ in the callisto repo; the current worktree (macos-15-runners) is locked while in use and has a stale name for its task.
Archived patches of discarded uncommitted work go in .claude/plans/archive/<name>/ inside the worktree.
`git cherry origin/main <branch>` showing `-` means the commit is already on main as an equivalent patch, so the branch is safe to delete even when `git branch --merged` doesn't list it.
`git branch -d` only deletes fully merged branches, so it works as a safety check after fetch --prune.
workflow: The permission classifier blocks `git push origin --delete` as destructive; give the user the command to run instead of retrying.
Before force-removing worktrees with uncommitted edits, check whether the touched files still exist on origin/main and archive the diffs as patches.
Don't skip cleanup of another job's artifacts out of caution alone; inspect them (git status, PR state, file existence on main) and then act.
Read the CI output for each check run locally instead of just trusting an exit status; the earlier clippy failure slipped through.
Record durable rules (e.g. worktree naming) in the memory directory with an index line in MEMORY.md.

friction: Remote branch deletion was denied by the classifier, so three merged remote branches remain.
The macos-15-runners worktree is locked because it's the current working directory, so it can't be removed in-session.
The earlier push to #470 left a failing clippy check (group_operations placed after the test module), which the user had to point out.
The assistant first skipped the slopfix branches and worktrees without inspecting them, prompting the user's question.
A stale worktree name (macos-15-runners) was reused for unrelated work.
open_items: User needs to run `git push origin --delete` for fix/config-and-error-conformance, fix/duration-token-scrub-git-failure, and fix/status-strict-and-artifact-input-message.
Remove the macos-15-runners worktree and fast-forward the main checkout (`git pull --ff-only`) once #470 merges and the session ends.
Confirm that CI and the gates for callisto/78 pass after the clippy fix push.
Decide on the agent git-access approach for the unreviewed `markers` work (feat/changeset-markers) and the `cli-io` restart.
Keep the agent-* worktrees and worktree-agent-* branches until #471 merges and the markers work is decided; keep feat/uncovered-changes (PR #471).
